page_title: EMP 0-1 CAG | Empoli v Cagliari 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' A cross from a corner kick by Empoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90+2' The game is interrupted as M'Baye Niang (Empoli) is flagged offside.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
87' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Gianluca Gaetano and he is replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
87' Substitution. Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) in, Gianluca Lapadula out.
86' Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
85' Razvan Marin (Empoli) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
83' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' That will be all from Sebastian Walukiewicz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alberto Cerri (Empoli).
79' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
78' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Tommaso Augello is replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Jakub Jankto.
76' The resulting set piece from Empoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
72' Here's the change. Liberato Cacace leaves the pitch and Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
72' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) replacing Viktor Kovalenko.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Cancellieri departs the field of play to be replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).

69' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Elia Caprile, so the score changes to 0:1.
68' The free kick from long range, taken by Empoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
65' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
64' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Empoli due to an offside in the build-up play.
62' The Empoli players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
62' Goal! Liberato Cacace (Empoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:0.

62' Simone Scuffet pulls off a fantastic save! Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.

62' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Empoli quickly take the free kick with a short pass.

60' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Antonio Rapuano stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Empoli are awarded a free kick.
58' Substitution. M'Baye Niang (Empoli) replaces Mattia Destro.
57' Razvan Marin (Empoli) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
56' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Empoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' The Empoli players can’t believe it after referee Antonio Rapuano signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
52' There's a break in play and referee Antonio Rapuano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Empoli using VAR. This could be interesting!
52' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
51' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
49' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
46' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) dribbles into the box, but Simone Scuffet is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Foul! Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Elia Caprile dived superbly to block a header by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Elia Caprile pulled off a remarkable save!
43' The foul by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
42' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.

38' Empoli exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
35' Ardian Ismajli somehow manages to send in a good cross towards the centre of the box from an acute angle, but the header from Mattia Destro (Empoli) flies well wide of the left post.
33' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Antonio Rapuano no option but to blow his whistle.
32' Zito Luvumbo is substituted due to injury. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
30' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
29' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari). Empoli will take a free kick.
28' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Razvan Marin (Empoli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
23' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul after Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
22' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
22' An attempted cross from Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Empoli are going to take it.
22' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
21' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) tries to find Jakub Jankto, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
19' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' The game is interrupted now, Yerry Mina (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

17' Simone Scuffet makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Youssef Maleh (Empoli) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
17' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the right post!
17' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

16' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the top of the net and Elia Caprile easily plucks the ball out of the air. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
14' The ball is cleared after Mattia Destro (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
13' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
12' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Elia Caprile (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Empoli will take a throw-in.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) heads on.
7' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation.

5' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
5' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Empoli.

4' A nice lofted cross finds Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
3' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will take a throw-in.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Antonio Rapuano.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
